query: How does the VFS look up a path component in the dentry cache before falling back to the filesystem?

matches.reason: Orchestrates the per-component walk: tries lookup_fast (dcache) first and only calls lookup_slow (filesystem ->lookup) on a cache miss.
Performs the racy/RCU dentry-cache lookup via __d_lookup_rcu/__d_lookup and revalidates it, returning NULL on a cache miss to trigger the slow path.
Core dentry-cache hash-table search comparing name and parent under RCU, the actual cache lookup primitive used by lookup_fast.
Fallback path invoked when the dentry isn't found in cache; allocates a dentry and calls the filesystem's inode ->lookup() method.
